location: Кусагакуре, центральный лазарет, изолированная диагностическая палата
actions: Player Shiki inspects metal medical plate brought up by Inaba, ordinary visual/tactile examination only, no chakra sensing invoked, no involuntary Shiki dialogue or personal interpretation asserted.

events.event: Inaba accesses inner seam of his traveling jacket with his left hand and passes jacket to Seina, who uses ordinary scissors to open seam. Metal plate falls onto desk. Inaba's right hand remains partly dysfunctional.

Rectangular pale gray noncorroded metal medical tag ~5x3 cm, ~2mm thick, worn tether hole polished at one corner. Machined regular engraving. FACE: «МЕДИЦИНСКИЙ РЕЕСТР», «М-4 / 031», «РЕЦИПИЕНТ», «Контроль: 7 суток». BACK: «Сложная тканевая трансплантация», «Экстренное обращение: медицинский узел М-4». No patient name. Edge shows six minuscule notches, four filled with dark hardened substance; function unknown. Four short slanted wave-like strokes near bottom resemble but do not exactly match official Kirigakure emblem; could be branch or workshop, authenticity not proven.

Claims tag lets participating clinic recognize his patient record and required weekly medicine; twice presented it at different medical posts over past 3 years and received medicines without questions. After second use was instructed not to display tag anymore because number already known to delivery network. This is patient's uncorroborated statement.

Seina says official Kiri medical data query could be made but would create trace, Inaba strongly refuses disclosure of his location. Seina honors consent and recommends first testing the physical tag itself and comparing format to Kusa archive, possibly later investigation of source if patient permits. She offers Shiki the plate on a clean napkin, awaits next direction.

facts: Tag inscription exactly as recorded and physical dimensions observed in scene.
The wave-like mark resembles Mist but is NOT proof it was issued by Kirigakure, nor proof of a direct Kabuto/Orochimaru connection.
Number M-4 / 031 identifies 'recipient' but no patient's name; neither medical network identity nor type of graft verified independently.
Six edge notches, four filled dark, have unknown purpose. No activation, chakra trap or secret marking deciphered.
Inaba opposes official query; medical confidentiality/consent stands.
No chakra used by Shiki during tag examination, nor clinical procedure chosen further.
